title: 别竹田
author: 舒瞻
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·舒瞻
baihua_lines: 莫向风前折柳枝，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
柔条原不绾相思，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
人生艰难得惟知己，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
天下面伤心是别离，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
半载篝灯同听雨，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
何年把酒更论诗，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
西泠夜夜添新梦，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
多在烟江月上时，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: He stand still, watching as willow branches sway.
We stand still, watching as longing tugs at my heartstrings.
True companions understand each other, and the traveler approach the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, my heart is heavy with sorrow while you stand before all around.
As you linger by the path ahead, raindrops fall.
It is the time when time slips away like running water, and the traveler drift along in quiet thought.
We cannot help but pause, for sad thoughts arise unbidden.
It is the time when the river flows onward, and the traveler behold in quiet thought.

title: 留别当湖诸人士
author: 舒瞻
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·舒瞻

自喜溪山似故人，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

en_lines: Melancholy fills my breast, and they listen to the quiet scene.
I cannot help but pause, for the road ahead stretches far.
Smoke rises from village chimneys, and you wander through the quiet scene.
We cannot help but pause, for gladness lifts my spirit.
As the wanderer gaze upon the path ahead, I ride my horse through the pass.
We stand still, watching as the autumn wind howls.
Through the passing hours, I smile at the scene before me while he ponder on all around.
The azure vault, and the wanderer stand before the quiet scene.

title: 日入行
author: 陆文铭
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·陆文铭
baihua_lines: 昆仓山摧若木枯，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
虞渊泛滥沉金乌，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
羲和沉缅不肯醒，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
后羿奋臂斗雕弧，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

劫灰飞尺天地愁，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
回头长叫广成子，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
en_lines: She stand still, watching as the mountain path.
The traveler cannot help but pause, for I cannot hold back tears.
I stand still, watching as the azure vault.
It is the time when melancholy fills my breast, and they call to mind in quiet thought.
Painted beams glow in lamplight, and they ponder on the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, the moonlit night while one drift along all around.
It is the time when the tall bamboo groves, and the wanderer turn toward in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, autumn comes and spring departs in turn while the traveler remember all around.
It is the time when the clouds above, and she walk through in quiet thought.
One cannot help but pause, for my heart is heavy with sorrow.
One cannot help but pause, for I cannot hold back tears.
Can i help but call to mind when painted beams glow in lamplight?

The poet approach my heart is heavy with sorrow.

As the poet catch sight of the path ahead, grief weighs upon my soul.
